## Kind of change

- [ ] Wording, example or translation (no effect on the requirements)

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated if a requirement changes
- [ ] Translations are updated, or flagged as needing an update
- [ ] No requirement imposes a technology, a product or a vendor
